reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI skin focused primarily on three cat-themed layouts, an interactive desktop companion, and related workspace panels and task views.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供三套猫咪主题、可互动桌面猫咪及配套工作台界面的插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that adds three cat-themed layouts, an interactive desktop companion, and related workspace interfaces.

capabilities: customizes the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with three bundled themes
provides an interactive cat companion with locally stored preferences
provides task organization and scheduled execution features
displays task, Git, file-panel, and usage-statistics interfaces
detects and adapts to the optional Better Sidebar plugin
